meshing.promotion_requirement: TQP-60 and TQP-61 primitive plus Gate E terrain differential evidence

buffer_residency.promotion_requirement: TQP-62 synchronization, reuse, stale rejection, targeted collision, and recovery evidence

collision.promotion_requirement: versioned readback within publication and latency budgets

qualified_scope: CPU world-transvoxel remains the pinned correctness reference and control authority
GPU field and regular plus transition meshing are selected candidate scopes
GPU residency, rendering, and collision readback remain separate promotion decisions
GPU results require CPU validation of page key, LOD, generation, source revision, world revision, and transition mask
explicitly_unqualified_scope: GPU regular or transition meshing correctness or performance
